desc:
👶 Welcome to My Pet Grumble! Raise a Grumble from DOORS👁️ in this game!

📏 While you play other Roblox games, your Grumble will grow larger and larger!

 ⌚Make sure to check in every few hours to play with them and check on their progress!

⭐ Once your Grumble reaches adulthood, you can set them out to work in The Nest and get a new Grumble!

🏞️ Released Grumbles will still visit you every so often!

Credits:
MilesGamingOdyssey (Current Owner): Music, Development, UI
Norrday (Previous Owner): Animation Contributor, Previous Builds of the Game (January, 2025 - September, 2025) 
DaHonourableAnimator: Animation Contributor
Game (idea inspired) by: My Pet Rock! 🪨
Assets: DOORS🚪

This game does not make any Robux from gamepasses or microtransactions! However, if the DOORS developers want to take this game down, they are allowed to.
